title: Federated Harbor — redteam probe template
description: Every probe filed by a redteam persona must validate against this schema. Probes that fail validation are sloppy and slash the bond.

id.description: Canonical smell identifier. Class matches persona's smell-prefix.

class.description: Persona's probe-class. One of the nine probe categories (folded by persona: trust=1, tokens=2+6, revocation=3, econ=4+5+7+8+9).

section.description: Target Federated Harbor section. §fh-N form, never bare §N.

persona.description: Which redteam persona filed the probe.

target.description: Concrete target: §, primitive, function, verifier rule. Not 'the federation', not 'security'. Specific.

tool.description: Mechanization tool used to construct the probe. `manual` is allowed but the construction field must be exceptionally rigorous.

hypothesis.description: The concrete claim under test. Falsifiable form: 'the verifier accepts T where paper rule says it should refuse'.

model.description: Path to the ProVerif/Tamarin/TLA+/Mesa model file, OR an inline minimal repro. If inline, ≤30 lines.

adversary_capabilities.description: What the adversary can do. Borrows from referenced canonical adversary models.

scope_assumptions.description: What the adversary CANNOT do. Names what the smell does NOT depend on.

result.description: What the probe showed. `partial` = paper claim holds under additional unstated assumption. `no-break-but-suspicious` = could not break it but rule is ambiguous.

observable.description: What concrete observation would refute the paper. 'A token accepted that paper rule says should refuse', not 'something bad happens'.

impact.description: What the adversary gains. Quantified when possible (extraction ratio, depletion rate, K colluders, etc.).

compared_to.description: Paper's stated safety threshold this metric exceeds.

metric.description: Required for econ-class probes; optional for others.

cross_paper.description: If the smell depends on an Anchor or Bonded claim, the cross-paper context.

bond.description: Reputation bond posted with the probe. Slashed on theatrical findings.
